limitations.name: Gameplay Windows / complete duel / real opponent decks
limitations.reason: No game image/catalog/decks/runtime; synthetic catalog and constructed board cannot prove live-game reachability.

limitations.name: Full effect/placement/field resolution
limitations.reason: Actual hand controller consumes cards; simple burn/placement-to-field and UI completion are modeled between actions.

limitations.name: Native stock AI interpreter when AI OFF / no-plan fallback
limitations.reason: AiScript_Init is actual code; AiScript_Run base fallback returns zero without executing disc bytecode. AI OFF test covers materializer chain only.

limitations.name: Full Mods_Apply/live UI lifecycle
limitations.reason: Actual manager ordering and hooks executed; late first load emulates activation sequence confirmed by mods.c, not full UI.

limitations.name: Global automatic order-only fix
limitations.reason: Safe startup H<D tested; late first-load can register H after already-loaded D despite configured H<D.

limitations.name: Production fix
limitations.reason: Diagnostic task only; no source, manifest, SDK or MOD objects changed.
